product_one_liner.value: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is an AI-powered financial-crime compliance platform for financial institutions and regulated businesses that screens customers and companies, monitors transactions and payments, and helps manage AML and fraud risk.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists plan options and a Starter price from $99/month.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in ComplyAdvantage customer stories.

employee_band.notes: Gartner lists the employee band as 201–500; PitchBook separately reports 474 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The technology blog index includes multiple engineering/build posts, including an LLM extraction-pipeline hallucination checker and a code-review agent.

public_docs.notes: The public Knowledge Base includes multiple product and API articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current board lists 15 roles across Commercial and Marketing; none of the listed job titles is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: ComplyAdvantage says Gemini is running in production for its LLM classification pipeline and identifies Google Gemini models in its private environment.

compliance_certs.notes: The company page names SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications and says GDPR aligned; no other listed certification is claimed there.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook lists the latest completed transaction as a $16.8 million general-debt deal dated May 19, 2025; this is a debt financing transaction rather than a new equity round.

raised_18mo.notes: The listed May 19, 2025 debt financing falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026; this is debt financing, not a venture-equity round.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current openings include Account Executive and Business Development Representative roles.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced Payment Screening on Mesh on May 19, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Damilola Payne’s profile lists a VP of Product role starting September 2026, and a dated executive-movement report says Payne joined in September 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A ComplyAdvantage Founding GTM Engineer job posting names these tools as systems to connect.
